page.layout: One printed title page, centred; no columns, no margin text. Inside a double-ruled frame: title block, then a woodcut ornament, then the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: E melioris apud ipsos notæ Authoribus in

page.notes: The title is set in mixed roman and italic capitals, with the large "ORIENTALIVM" and "ED: POCOCKI" in display capitals. Words such as "Oriental", "ALIQUAM-MULTA" and "Linguae" are as printed. The woodcut ornament between the rules carries no text. The scan is slightly skewed and faded at the left edge, but all printed lines are legible. The imprint year reads 1648 (printed "1648" with the 6 and 4 in the same face).
